# telnyx_voice_channel_zone (Resource)

The number of voice channels in a non-US zone. Zones cannot be created or deleted; destroy removes it from Terraform state only.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Zones cannot be created or deleted; destroy only removes this from state.
resource "telnyx_voice_channel_zone" "example" {
  channel_zone_id = var.channel_zone_id
  channels        = 10
}

variable "channel_zone_id" {
  type = string
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `channel_zone_id` (String) The channel zone id.
- `channels` (Number) The number of reserved channels

### Read-Only

- `countries` (List of String) List of countries (in ISO 3166-2, capitalized) members of the billing channel zone
- `created_at` (String) ISO 8601 formatted date of when the channel zone was created
- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `name` (String)
- `record_type` (String)
- `updated_at` (String) ISO 8601 formatted date of when the channel zone was updated

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import telnyx_voice_channel_zone.example <channel_zone_id>
```
